fusions.name: Hollow Ping
fusions.desc: Sends out a ping that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds: your abilities hurt it more and it shows on the map.

fusions.name: Struck Bell
fusions.desc: Rings your shell, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. Each has a 30% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Brumation
fusions.desc: Veils you in the dark for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and the veil breaks the moment you attack. It also restores 14 health.

fusions.name: Hibernaculum
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 14%. Your dodge chance is 4% higher at all times.
